BiblicalUsage: Seneh is the southern crag at the pass of Michmash, the sharp rock on the one side of Jonathan's way up to the Philistine garrison. The name marks the ground Jonathan climbed to reach the enemy.
TheologicalSignificance: To me, Seneh is a reminder that God marks the hard ground His people crossed, and this crag is named because Jonathan climbed it.
